content: {"phoneNote":"The hero photo on phone is badly cropped, cutting off the car on the lift at the very top and leaving an empty garage floor in the middle of the screen.","desktopNote":"In the tire storage section on desktop, the headline awkwardly breaks the word 'ZAMENJAMO' across two lines ('ZAMENJAM / O IN').","phone":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":5,"imagery":2,"spacing":4,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":5},"desktop":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":4,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":5},"fixes":["Adjust the mobile hero image crop (e.g. object-position: top or center-top) so the lifted car is clearly visible instead of the empty garage floor.","Reduce the font size or widen the text column for 'GUME ZAMENJAMO IN SHRANIMO' on desktop so 'ZAMENJAMO' does not break mid-word without a hyphen.","Use the license-plate motif only for the phone number CTA and present the service prices as clean typography so the clever plate gimmick isn't overused."]}
